title: マイルCS南部杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I've been thinking. Running in both the turf and dirt Mile Championships is the perfect move for a true all-rounder!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, here we are in Morioka for the Mile Championship Nambu Hai.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Gwehehe! My, oh mile, it's the Mile Championship Nambu Hai!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm ready! I've toughened this bod to handle anything Mother Nature's got to throw at me, be it squall or gale!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: You know it! It took a lot of time and hard work, but I've finally mastered this region's accent!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'll be blend'n right in with the local folks all easy peasy lem'n squeezy, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fwehehahaha! I'm feel'n so peachy! The peachiest!
Ah! There y're, Digital! I found you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I'd recognize that darling voice anywhere… A voice as soft and fluffy as the tail of its owner, completely befitting her peaceful demeanor. It can be none other than the Morioka's own Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. You're spot on! I'm here visit'n home, so I just had to swing by and cheer for you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I brought some classic Moriokan snacks too. You can have 'em before the race or whenev'r you happen t'get hungry.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Did you hear that, Trainer?! Yukino took precious time out of her precious trip to come support me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And she brought me a gift! Look! Nambu is famous for these crispy, savory rice crackers!
choice_data_list: Now you have to show her your top game!
Now you have to show her your top game!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes sir! A good fan never lets her oshi down!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Yes ma'am! A good fan never lets her oshi down!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I want to make Yukino proud, and I also want to fully savor the natural charms of the Tohoku runners. Which means…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna blast through at full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Brimming with excitement after receiving Yukino Bijin's priceless support, Agnes Digital heads to the waiting room.
